title: Tattenai’s Letter to Darius

questions.question: Which prophets prophesied to the Jews?
questions.explanation: Ezra 5:1 (ESV): "Now the prophets, Haggai and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied to the Jews..."

questions.question: Who rose up to rebuild the house of God?
questions.explanation: Ezra 5:2 (ESV): "Then Zerubbabel... and Jeshua... arose and began to rebuild the house of God..."

questions.question: Who was the governor of the province Beyond the River?
questions.explanation: Ezra 5:3 (ESV): "At the same time Tattenai the governor of the province Beyond the River..."

questions.question: What did Tattenai ask them?
options: Who gave you a decree to build this house?
questions.correctAnswer: Who gave you a decree to build this house?
questions.explanation: Ezra 5:3 (ESV): "...Who gave you a decree to build this house and to finish this structure?"

questions.question: Why did they not stop building?
options: The eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews
questions.correctAnswer: The eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews
questions.explanation: Ezra 5:5 (ESV): "But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews, and they did not stop them..."

questions.question: To whom did Tattenai send a report?
questions.explanation: Ezra 5:6 (ESV): "This is a copy of the letter that Tattenai... sent to Darius the king."

questions.question: How was the work described in the letter?
options: It is being done with diligence and goes fast in their hands
questions.correctAnswer: It is being done with diligence and goes fast in their hands
questions.explanation: Ezra 5:8 (ESV): "...this work is being done with diligence and goes fast in their hands."

questions.question: What decree did the Jews cite?
options: The decree of Cyrus king of Babylon
questions.correctAnswer: The decree of Cyrus king of Babylon
questions.explanation: Ezra 5:13 (ESV): "However, in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, Cyrus the king made a decree..."

questions.question: Who did Cyrus appoint as governor?
questions.explanation: Ezra 5:14 (ESV): "...whom he had made governor, whom he called Sheshbazzar."

questions.question: What did Tattenai request Darius to do?
options: Search the royal archives in Babylon
questions.correctAnswer: Search the royal archives in Babylon
questions.explanation: Ezra 5:17 (ESV): "...let search be made in the royal archives there in Babylon, to see whether a decree was issued by Cyrus..."

questions.question: How did the Jews describe themselves to Tattenai?
options: The servants of the God of heaven and earth
questions.correctAnswer: The servants of the God of heaven and earth
questions.explanation: Ezra 5:11 (ESV): "...We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth..."

questions.question: Why was the house of God destroyed according to their answer?
options: Because our fathers had angered the God of heaven
questions.correctAnswer: Because our fathers had angered the God of heaven
questions.explanation: Ezra 5:12 (ESV): "But because our fathers had angered the God of heaven, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar..."

questions.question: Who destroyed the house and carried the people away?
options: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean
questions.correctAnswer: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean
questions.explanation: Ezra 5:12 (ESV): "...Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house and carried the people away..."

questions.question: Did the work really stop since Sheshbazzar laid the foundations?
options: It has been under construction and is not yet finished
questions.correctAnswer: It has been under construction and is not yet finished
questions.explanation: Ezra 5:16 (ESV): "...and from that time until now it has been under construction and is not yet finished."

questions.question: Who was with Tattenai in sending the letter?
options: Shethar-bozenai and his associates the governors
questions.correctAnswer: Shethar-bozenai and his associates the governors
questions.explanation: Ezra 5:6 (ESV): "...and Shethar-bozenai and his associates the governors who were in the province Beyond the River..."

key_verse_text: And this was their reply to us: “We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and we are rebuilding the house that was built many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and finished.”
